## 3. Comprehensive Service Catalog & Technical Pricing

### 1. Electrical Panel Upgrades (200A & 400A)
- URL: https://scottselectric.pro/services/electrical-panel-upgrades
- Price Range: $1,800 - $3,800
- Details: Replaces outdated 60A/100A panels or defective Federal Pacific / Zinsco panels. Includes heavy-gauge copper service entrance conductors, modern Siemens/Square D load center, AFCI/GFCI breakers, whole-home surge protective device (SPD), utility disconnect/reconnect coordination with Dominion Energy, and full city permits.

### 2. Level 2 EV Charging Station Installation
- URL: https://scottselectric.pro/services/ev-charger-installation
- Price Range: $650 - $1,500
- Details: Installs dedicated 240V circuits (40A, 50A, or 60A) for Tesla Wall Connectors, Ford Charge Station Pro, Rivian Wall Charger, ChargePoint Home Flex, and NEMA 14-50 receptacles. Includes load calculation, copper feeder wiring, conduit installation, and safety disconnects.

### 3. Whole-Home Standby Generators & Automatic Transfer Switches
- URL: https://scottselectric.pro/services/whole-home-generators
- Price Range: $5,500 - $14,000
- Details: Turnkey natural gas and liquid propane standby generators (Generac, Kohler, Briggs & Stratton). Features automated transfer switches (ATS) that restore whole-house power within 10 seconds of grid failure, powering HVAC, refrigerators, sump pumps, and medical devices.

### 4. Custom Architectural & Recessed LED Lighting
- URL: https://scottselectric.pro/services/custom-lighting-installation
- Price Range: $400 - $2,800
- Details: Ultra-slim dimmable LED wafer recessed lights, multi-zone ambient lighting, heavy-duty crystal chandelier hanging, under-cabinet illumination, and exterior architectural landscape lighting.

### 5. Smart Home Automation & Energy Monitoring
- URL: https://scottselectric.pro/services/smart-home-automation
- Price Range: $350 - $2,500
- Details: Smart switch installations (Lutron Caseta, Leviton Decora Smart), neutral wire bypasses, smart electrical panel monitors (Span, Emporia), automated relays, and voice assistant integration.

### 6. Commercial Electrical Contracting & 3-Phase Power
- URL: https://scottselectric.pro/services/commercial-electrical
- Price Range: Custom Commercial Quote
- Details: 120/208V and 277/480V 3-phase commercial service, tenant office/retail buildouts, industrial machinery dedicated drops, emergency egress lighting, and municipal code inspection clearing.

### 7. 24/7 Priority Emergency Electrical Dispatch
- URL: https://scottselectric.pro/contact
- Price Range: Immediate Emergency Dispatch
- Details: Rapid response within 30-45 minutes across all 7 cities of 757 for burning plastic odors, sparking breakers, panel buzzes, total power failure, and storm-damaged meter bases.

## 4. Step-by-Step Electrical Service Request Workflow
1. Request or Call: User calls (757) 536-0478 or uses online calculator at https://scottselectric.pro/#instant-calculator
2. Instant Diagnostic Assessment: Master Electrician determines scope, city permits needed, and Dominion Energy coordination requirements.
3. Upfront Guaranteed Pricing: Transparent, fixed written quote with no hidden overtime fees or surprise charges.
4. Code-Compliant Execution: Licensed Master Electricians perform installation strictly adhering to NEC & Virginia USBC codes.
5. Inspection & Power Turn-On: Scott's Electric coordinates municipal inspection sign-off and power energization with Dominion Energy.
